\n分批准备，每批最多 4 名；分别显示资料／资源与地图激活进度，缺额核对后最多: Prepared in batches of up to 4. Profile / asset and map activation progress are shown separately. Missing spawns are checked and retried at most twice.

逐件装备与储物格编辑需要单选一名 AI；多选可批量修改行为、Buff、预设枪械或: Editing individual equipment and storage grids requires one AI. Multiple selections support behavior, buffs, weapon presets and weapon deletion in batches.

头盔与防弹衣不掉耐久: No equipped helmet or armor wear
仅保护本地玩家当前穿戴的头盔、面罩附件、防弹衣和装甲胸挂；不修改 AI 或背包里: Protects only the local player's equipped helmet, face protection attachments, body armor and armored rig. AI and carried spare equipment are unchanged. Hit and damage calculations are unchanged.
保留修复前的最大耐久，费用照常；不恢复历史最大耐久损耗，不影响修理包。: Preserves the maximum durability from before the repair, with normal fees. Does not recover earlier maximum durability loss or affect repair kits.
允许物品箱放进其他物品箱，保持真实格数及防循环嵌套检查；修改后需重启服务端并重新: Allows cases inside other cases while preserving their actual grid size and checks against nesting loops. Restart the server and log in again after changing this to reload templates.
使用已有钥匙时保留当前剩余次数，继续显示原始数值；按钥匙原本适配的锁具正常使用。: Preserves the remaining uses of keys you own while keeping their original displayed values. Keys still work only with their intended locks.
商人修复需要服务端模块 1.5.0；更新后重启服务端生效。: Trader repair requires server module 1.5.0. Restart the server after updating.
\n商人按原规则收费，修复前最大耐久保留；修理包保持原规则。头甲保护只作用于你当: Traders charge normally and preserve pre-repair maximum durability. Repair kits follow native rules. Armor protection applies only to your equipped armor and its armor attachments.
\n当前客户端没有可用的钥匙消耗接口，此版本无法启用钥匙保护。: No key consumption interface is available in this client. Key protection cannot be enabled in this version.
准星实际指向允许的存活 AI 时自动扣动扳机，不转动视角；共用自瞄排除规则。: Pulls the trigger when the crosshair points at an eligible living AI without turning the camera. Shares aim target exclusions.
None 表示开启后持续检测；可设为侧键等按住触发。: None checks continuously while enabled. Assign a mouse side button or another key to require holding it.
准星连续停留在同一名 AI 上才开火。: Fires only after the crosshair stays on the same AI for this duration.
正常武器射速仍然有效。: The weapon's normal rate of fire still applies.

\n每 5 分钟更新；断网时保留最后一次成功行情。商人收购价随行情自动更新。: Updates every 5 minutes. The last successful quote is retained offline. Trader buyout prices update with the quote.
仅在原生光学瞄具摄像机中绘制上色，镜外保留原始人物材质。红点、机瞄不启用此模式。: Renders character colors only through the native optical scope camera. Original materials remain outside the scope. Does not apply to red dots or iron sights.
直视部分使用明亮阵营色，遮挡部分使用暗色和较低透明度。: Visible parts use bright faction colors; occluded parts use darker, more transparent colors.

在英文和俄文之间切换 BOSS 透视名称；没有对应译名的呼号保留原名。: Switches boss ESP names between English and Russian. Callsigns without a translation retain their original names.
隐藏并停用本局 BTR 车辆、显示模型及射手；关闭此开关后恢复，地图原有路线与出: Hides and disables this raid's BTR, its visual model and gunner. Turning this off restores them; the map's native route and spawn timing still apply.

命中后保留的时间。: How long trails remain after impact.

开启或关闭本组功能。: Enable or disable this feature group.
显示存活人物的位置、身份与生命值，Ctrl+F6 切换；尸体显示也受 Ctrl+: Shows living characters' positions, identities and health. Toggle with Ctrl+F6, which also controls corpse markers.
显示当前／最大生命值和血条。: Show current / maximum health and health bars.
显示地面物品、容器和尸体内物品，Ctrl+F7 切换。: Show ground items and items inside containers and corpses. Toggle with Ctrl+F7.
显示可搜索的容器；看向标记时在固定面板查看详情。: Show searchable containers. Look at a marker to view details in a fixed panel.
存活人物标记的最大显示距离，尸体范围可在尸体显示分组单独设置。: Maximum distance for living character markers. Corpse range is configured separately under Corpse ESP.
地面物品及容器标记的最大距离，不限制尸体定位距离。: Maximum distance for ground item and container markers. Does not limit corpse location markers.
超过数量时优先显示近处物品。: When the limit is exceeded, nearby items take priority.
调整本组文字显示大小。: Adjust text size for this feature group.
切换人物及尸体标记，默认 Ctrl+F6。: Toggle character and corpse markers. Default: Ctrl+F6.
切换物品、容器及尸体物品详情，默认 Ctrl+F7。: Toggle items, containers and corpse contents. Default: Ctrl+F7.
切换本地玩家的无敌状态，默认 Ctrl+F8。: Toggle local player invulnerability. Default: Ctrl+F8.
切换敌人是否忽略你，默认 Ctrl+F9。: Toggle whether enemies ignore you. Default: Ctrl+F9.
文字、阴影、底板、边框和标记的统一不透明度。0 为隐藏，50 为半透明，100: Shared opacity for text, shadows, panels, borders and markers. 0 hides them, 50 is translucent, and 100 is fully visible.
按价格快照计算堆叠和附件估值，不是实时成交价。: Estimates stacks and attachments using a price snapshot, not live transaction prices.
看向容器标记时展开容器名称、物品和估值。: Look at a container marker to expand its name, contents and estimated value.
此距离内显示容器和尸体中的物品详情。: Show container and corpse contents within this distance.
优先列出高价物品；未列出的物品仍计入总估值。: Lists valuable items first. Items omitted from the list still count toward the total estimate.
每次扫描评估最近的这些容器，相邻同类容器合并为一组。: Evaluate this many nearby containers per scan. Adjacent containers of the same type are grouped.
物品或堆叠估值达到此金额时显示橙色。: Items or stacks worth at least this much appear orange.
即使被墙壁遮挡，也显示人物着色轮廓。: Show colored character outlines even behind walls.
关闭：停用自瞄；暴力：视角直接瞄向选中部位；静默：调整本地子弹方向；微自瞄：缓慢: Off disables aiming. Rage turns the view directly toward the chosen body part. Silent adjusts local bullet direction. Soft aim moves gradually toward the chosen part.
选择辅助瞄准锁定的身体部位，默认头部。: Body part for aim assist. Default: Head.
按住此键激活选中的自瞄模式；Mouse4 是鼠标侧键。: Hold this key to activate the selected aim mode. Mouse4 is a mouse side button.
无需按住激活键；关闭模式仍停用自瞄，不会自动开枪。: No activation key is required. Off mode still disables aiming. Does not fire automatically.
切换常开与按住激活，默认 Ctrl+F4。: Toggle between always active and hold to activate. Default: Ctrl+F4.
循环切换关闭、暴力和静默模式，默认 Ctrl+F3。: Cycle Off, Rage and Silent aim. Default: Ctrl+F3.
从视野中心选取目标的最大夹角。: Maximum target acquisition angle from the center of the view.
本组功能的最大作用距离。: Maximum operating distance for this feature group.
此范围内优先选取近距离威胁，并扩大允许角度。: Prioritize nearby threats within this range and allow a wider acquisition angle.
近距离威胁允许使用的目标选取角度。: Allowed acquisition angle for nearby threats.
要求镜头到选中部位没有遮挡；静默穿掩体开启时，静默模式不受此项限制。: Require a clear line from the camera to the chosen body part. Silent aim ignores this requirement when Silent through cover is enabled.
静默子弹可选取被掩体遮挡的 AI；遮挡时修正子弹起点。火箭仍有碰撞。: Silent bullets can target AI behind cover, adjusting the bullet origin when obstructed. Rockets still collide normally.
按住正常开火键时，两发火箭之间的最短时间。: Minimum time between rockets while holding the normal fire button.
抑制本地玩家开枪时的枪械后坐力和相关镜头上跳，独立于自瞄模式；关闭后后续射击恢复: Suppress local weapon recoil and related camera kick independently of aim mode. Turning this off restores recoil for subsequent shots.
命中与击杀提示保留时间。: How long hit and kill notifications remain visible.
保留最近的这些命中／击杀提示。: Keep this many recent hit / kill notifications.
看向尸体标记时显示装备、背包及口袋内物品，需要开启 Ctrl+F7 物品显示。: Look at a corpse marker to view equipment, backpack and pockets. Ctrl+F7 item ESP must be enabled.
BOSS 的人物轮廓与标签颜色，默认红色；填写 #RRGGBB 十六进制颜色。: Boss outline and label color. Default: Red. Enter a #RRGGBB hex color.
BOSS 随从的人物轮廓与标签颜色，默认紫色；填写 #RRGGBB。: Boss follower outline and label color. Default: Purple. Enter #RRGGBB.
邪教徒的人物轮廓与标签颜色，默认黄色；填写 #RRGGBB。: Cultist outline and label color. Default: Yellow. Enter #RRGGBB.
普通感染者的人物轮廓与标签颜色，默认荧光黄绿；填写 #RRGGBB。感染大锤继续: Normal infected outline and label color. Default: Fluorescent yellow-green. Infected Tagilla retains the boss color. Enter #RRGGBB.
普通 Scav 的人物轮廓与标签颜色，默认绿色；填写 #RRGGBB。: Scav outline and label color. Default: Green. Enter #RRGGBB.
掠夺者的人物轮廓与标签颜色，默认橙色；填写 #RRGGBB。: Raider outline and label color. Default: Orange. Enter #RRGGBB.
游荡者的人物轮廓与标签颜色，默认青色；填写 #RRGGBB。: Rogue outline and label color. Default: Cyan. Enter #RRGGBB.
黑色军团及黑色军团活动变体的人物轮廓与标签颜色，默认粉色；填写 #RRGGBB。: Black Division and event variant outline and label color. Default: Pink. Enter #RRGGBB.
PMC 的人物轮廓与标签颜色，默认蓝色；填写 #RRGGBB。: PMC outline and label color. Default: Blue. Enter #RRGGBB.
分别显示 BOSS、保镖、邪教徒、Scav、掠夺者、游荡者、黑色军团、PMC 的: Shows living bosses, followers, cultists, Scavs, Raiders, Rogues, Black Division and PMCs, with PMCs split into USEC and BEAR. Counts only characters that have spawned and are still alive.
显示本地图黑车、绿烟、拉闸点的实际状态，包括未分配给你的点。: Shows actual vehicle, green flare and power switch extraction states on this map, including exits not assigned to you.
关闭、按住显示或常开；默认按住 + 键显示。: Off, Hold or Always on. Default: Hold + to display.
按住此键显示撤离／转移信息窗口，不需要 Ctrl；默认 +，也支持小键盘 +。: Hold to display extraction / transit information without Ctrl. Default: +; numpad + also works.
撤离／转移信息窗口的宽度，默认 440 像素。: Extraction / transit panel width. Default: 440 pixels.
关闭、按住显示或常开；默认与撤离窗口一样按住 + 键显示，也可单独改键。: Off, Hold or Always on. Defaults to holding + like the extraction panel, but its key can be set independently.
按住此键显示当前弹夹内的子弹信息，默认 +；可独立设置。: Hold to show ammunition in the current magazine. Default: +. Configurable independently.
左侧弹夹信息窗口的宽度。: Width of the magazine information panel on the left.
窗口最多列出的 AI 数量，优先显示当前锁定你的 AI。: Maximum AI listed in the panel. AI currently targeting you take priority.
关闭、仅显示最近可用撤离点，或显示所有已加载撤离点；同名出口合并显示，标记附带直: Off, nearest available extraction, or all loaded extractions. Exits sharing a name are merged. Markers show straight-line distance.
标出与撤离点关联的开关位置、距离和开启状态；可独立于撤离点标记开关控制。: Marks switches linked to extractions, with distance and activation state. Controlled independently of extraction markers.
仅补满本地玩家的腿部体力，关闭后恢复正常消耗。: Refills only the local player's leg stamina. Turning this off restores normal consumption.
仅补满本地玩家的手臂体力，关闭后恢复正常消耗。: Refills only the local player's arm stamina. Turning this off restores normal consumption.
仅提高本地玩家步行与冲刺速度，关闭后恢复原速。: Increases only the local player's walking and sprinting speed. Turning this off restores the original speed.
人物加速开启时使用；1.0 为原速，可设为 1.0～5.0 倍，默认 1.5 倍: Used while the speed boost is enabled. 1.0 is normal; accepts 1.0–5.0. Default: 1.5.
状态面板显示的最大撤离点数量，优先可用点和特殊撤离点。: Maximum extractions shown in the status panel. Available and special exits take priority.
尝试启用地图已加载但未分配给你的本阵营普通出口，默认关闭，Ctrl+F10 切换: Attempts to enable loaded, unassigned regular exits for your faction. Off by default; toggle with Ctrl+F10. Retains payment, key, equipment and switch requirements. Does not spawn vehicles or trains or force secret exits.
切换强制启用未分配普通出口，默认 Ctrl+F10。关闭后恢复原分配；已开始的正: Toggle enabling unassigned regular exits. Default: Ctrl+F10. Disabling restores the original assignments without interrupting a normal extraction countdown already in progress.
